verdict.rationale: The MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator with an on-premise software stack (ROCm, SMI, Kubernetes tooling). It does not hold user data in a vendor-hosted account, so "export all my data and leave" is a SaaS data-portability question that does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a vendor-held data store that could be exported. ROCm being open source is a separate openness and lock-in matter, not data export.
